target_customer: Fantasy Premier League players, especially those in mini leagues with friends or colleagues
problem: Fantasy sports players discuss their teams in generic chats and social networks with no home for their identity or live match talk.
business_model: Free consumer app; monetization not found

founders.name: Neil Murray
founders.background_notes: YC page says he is Founding Partner of The Nordic Web Ventures, an angel fund.

competitors.name: Mini League Mate
competitors.what: Weekly email stats and bragging rights updates for Fantasy Premier League mini leagues

technical_complexity.rationale: Group chat, live scores and stats built on the public FPL data for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Depends on the official FPL data and users' existing chat apps; a dealroom note says the social layer lacked a moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The dealroom note says the official platform and general social networks kept the conversation.

market_need_then: The founder's 2020-02-12 announcement cited 7 to 8 million FPL players; no hard evidence of unmet demand.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch listed 2020-08-20; no further community evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Several unrelated products named Playmaker or Playmakers dilute search; no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Playmaker launched its app in autumn 2020, joined YC in Winter 2021 with YC funding only, and is listed as inactive. A dealroom note argues the social layer lacked a moat against the official FPL tools and general networks, but no shutdown notice or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: Funding rests on databases (Seedtable 130K pre-seed January 2021, CB Insights seed 2021-02-01) and is likely the YC deal. A directory claims bankruptcy in 2022 with no primary source; not recorded. The site getplaymaker.app returned 403 on fetch. Education and prior employers not found.
